purpose: Authoritative registry for historical Taiwan price sources. Registration is not activation; a source may enter StockLab only after the actual subscription/licence, product fields, delivery rights and private ingestion are verified.

ogdl_daily_forward_archive.note: The open-data daily snapshot is archived from the date StockLab started collecting it. It does not create earlier historical OHLC that was never obtained.

twse_eshop_daily_close.product_page_external_use_wording: Subscriber may use internally and transmit subscribed product content to its information users; remaining conditions are subject to Internet Online Subscription Terms.
activation_requirements: operator explicitly orders the appropriate product/use type
applicable Internet Online Subscription Terms are accepted and retained
automated processing, derived analysis and private storage rights are explicitly confirmed
delivery files are ingested privately with provenance and SHA-256 checksums
raw rows are never committed to the public repository
raw rows are not redistributed beyond the contract scope

tpex_eshop_afterhours_api.product: 盤後資料 - API 說明
tpex_eshop_afterhours_api.reason_not_activated: The public product page confirms external-use ordering and historical ordering, but does not itself prove that the delivered API product contains the complete OHLCV history required by the holding OOS model.

tpex_eshop_afterhours_history.product: 盤後資料 - 歷史資料 - 成交檔
activation_requirements: subscription/order and member terms are explicitly completed
exact delivered fields and usable historical range are verified
automated processing, derived analysis and private storage rights are explicitly confirmed
delivery is ingested privately with provenance and SHA-256 checksums
raw rows are never committed to the public repository
use is limited to rights granted by the order terms
